clinical_status: Undergoing clinical trial and clinical validation. Engineering performance is validated; clinical validity is not yet established.
intended_use: Risk assessment, visual-feature analysis and clinical decision support. Not an autonomous medical diagnosis system.

components.name: Skin Relevance Classification (gate)
components.deployed_here: CLIP ViT-B/16 zero-shot prompt-ensemble gate (trained EfficientNetV2-S checkpoint not present in repository; drop-in via RELEVANCE_BACKEND=effnet)
components.role: Terminal decision point. A rejected image returns a not-analysable payload and never reaches the analysis models.

components.name: Disease-Likelihood Vision Classification
components.documented_model: DINOv2 ViT-L/14 (T11_dinov2_l14_deep_long_final), 304.4M params, CLS + mean-patch fusion, MLP head

training.dedup: dHash + verification pass; test split untouched
training.stages: 12 ep frozen -> 46 ep with 8/24 blocks unfrozen, LLRD 0.75

ensemble.selection: Caruana greedy forward selection on validation probabilities only
ensemble.note: Identical accuracy to the single model; higher ROC-AUC (0.9920 -> 0.9954), which benefits the threshold-based escalation and confidence decisions. Deployed here as the default; LIKELIHOOD_MODE=single reproduces the documented single-model configuration.

components.deployed_here: Ensemble (T11 + T09 + T05, validation-selected weights), fp16, preprocessing identical to evaluation path

components.name: Visual Abnormality Instance Segmentation (VAIS)
components.deployed_here: Fusion segmenter (substitute for the absent YOLO weights): proposals from Qwen3-VL lesion grounding (semantic labels, relative 0-1000 boxes), Grounding DINO (tiny) morphology prompts and the classifier's attention map are merged by weighted box fusion (confidence rises with the number of independent sources that agree); SAM 2.1 (hiera-small) turns each fused box into a pixel mask; the second-reader VLM then reviews every numbered region and single-source proposals it rejects are removed. Feature extraction (area ratio, bbox, centroid, perimeter, circularity, solidity, shape descriptor, cluster summary) is unchanged. YOLO weights drop in via VAIS_BACKEND=yolo.
components.role: Non-terminal. Instance counts are ordinal signals (none / few / several / many), not exact tallies.

fusion.vlm_grounding_skipped_when: classifier reads the image as confidently normal

components.name: Vision-Language Second Reader
components.deployed_here: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct (4-bit NF4) by default: it is grounding-capable, so one resident model serves as lesion grounder, second reader, instance reviewer and chat assistant on a 6 GB GPU. google/medgemma-4b-it (medically tuned, cannot emit boxes) via VLM_BACKEND=medgemma; on a larger GPU pair it with a dedicated grounder via VAIS_VLM_GROUNDER=Qwen/Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct.
components.role: Grounds lesions for the fusion segmenter, describes visible findings, checks consistency with the classifier, reviews each segmented region, lists red flags, writes the plain-language note and answers follow-up questions. It never overrides the measured classifier and its text is labelled as model-generated.

limitations: Data volume is the binding constraint: three classes trained on fewer than 400 genuine images after de-duplication; HSV is the weakest class (F1 0.89).
Errors concentrate in the ulcerative-lesion cluster (warts/HSV/syphilis/candidiasis), which still routes to assessment.
The relevance gate does not assess image quality; blur/exposure heuristics are reported but not gating.
End-to-end chained sensitivity has not been measured on a single held-out set.
The VLM can hallucinate; its output is advisory and must never be surfaced as a diagnosis.

The relevance gate and the fusion segmenter deployed here are substitutes for the documented trained models and have no measured accuracy on this domain; multi-source agreement and the second-reader review reduce, but do not eliminate, false localisations.
